stats.fact: MarkMem stores chatbot memory as plain markdown in a git repo; SQLite is a rebuildable cache (delete it and `markmem reindex` restores from markdown)
MarkMem combines three unique pillars: bi-temporal facts in YAML, Presidio as a PII write gate, and git as the compliance surface
MarkMem LoCoMo R@5 evidence recall: 83.3% vs Mem0 92.5%, Letta/MemGPT 68.5%, Khoj 83.2%
MarkMem search latency p50: 1.5ms vs Mem0 880ms; context packing latency p50 2.0ms
MarkMem multi-user isolation: 100% (0 leaks); temporal reasoning supersession accuracy 100%; GDPR erasure (crypto-shred + tombstone) 230.5ms
MarkMem supports 100+ LLMs via LiteLLM, BM25+Vector RRF fusion, MCP server, REST API, and 19 CLI commands
MarkMem limitation: ~50-100K pages per repo (many small files is git's and NTFS's worst case); FTS5 stemming is English-biased
Incumbent memory layers: mem0 64.8K stars, Khoj 37.1K, Graphiti 30.6K, Letta 24.6K, basic-memory 3.8K, memweave 54
MarkMem is Apache-2.0, Python, published on PyPI as `markmem`; created 2026-08-18

angles: The 'inspectable memory' argument: vector DBs trade away the ability to cat/grep/git-diff your own memory — MarkMem restores it
Compliance-first memory: git log as audit trail, provable path-scoped GDPR erasure, crypto-shred against backups
Bi-temporal facts solve silent overwrite: old facts are closed (valid_until) and superseded, enabling as_of temporal reasoning
PII safety at the write gate: Presidio blocks/masks SSNs, emails, credit cards before they hit disk
Zero-hard-dependency design: no vector extra → BM25 only; no LLM key → heuristic extractor; core never imports torch
Portability: lossless export to jsonl, migrate to/from mem0, export to Claude Code memory-md format
The ecosystem gap: only tool combining markdown + hybrid search + git compliance + bi-temporal facts
